name: Currency conversion rate config
expected: CurrencyType.ConversionRate maintained at authoritative rates per Confluence table (ARS=666.6667, CHF=0.885, GBP=0.7874, ILS=3.6251, JPY=149.2537, NZD=1.6667). Reports / dashboards / DocGen / Workday invoicing consolidate foreign currencies at correct rates. Fortra Japan KK (0fwWC0000000CNlYAM) is the primary JPY legal entity (Workday COM071). Exactly 5 currencies in scope per official spec (USD/EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD). JPY DecimalPlaces=0.
actual: CurrencyType.ConversionRate corrupted on 6 of 11 non-USD currencies (all at placeholder 1.0): ARS=1.0 (auth 666.6667), CHF=1.0 (auth 0.8850), GBP=1.0 (auth 0.7874), ILS=1.0 (auth 3.6251), JPY=1.0 (auth 149.2537), NZD=1.0 (auth 1.6667). DatedConversionRate (Advanced Currency Mgmt ON) confirms ARS/CHF/GBP/JPY reset to 1.0 on 2026-02-11/12/13; any foreign txn dated >= 2026-02-11 consolidates at face value (e.g. JPY 221M shown as USD 221M). 12 active currencies vs 5-in-scope and 10-in-Confluence-doc (MXN/SEK are orphans). AUD 1.52 / CAD 1.35 / EUR 0.92 also drift from authoritative 1.5385/1.3889/0.9346. Pricing proc V21 is CLEAN: decoupled via Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt which holds correct rates (ARS 666.6667, AUD 1.5385, CAD 1.3889, CHF 0.885, EUR 0.9346, GBP 0.7874, ILS 3.6251, JPY 149.2537, NZD 1.6667, USD 1.0). JPY DecimalPlaces=0 is CORRECT. Fortra Japan KK 0fwWC0000000CNlYAM Status=Active CurrencyIsoCode=JPY Workday_Reference_ID__c=COM071 is correct; Legal_Entity_Currency__mdt Fortra_Japan_JPY Is_Primary=true. Places__c has no Default_Legal_Entity__c field (field is on Account). Total DatedConversionRate rows=299 (unchanged from run1).
evidence: CurrencyType query 2026-06-30: ARS/CHF/GBP/ILS/JPY/NZD ConversionRate=1.0; JPY DecimalPlaces=0 CORRECT. DatedConversionRate ARS 1428.5714->1.0 @2026-02-11; GBP 0.7421->1.0 @2026-02-11; JPY 156.25->1.0 @2026-02-11; CHF 0000-12-30=1.0 (never had a real rate in UAT). Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt 10 records all active with correct authoritative rates (confirmed via Apex). LegalEntity Fortra Japan KK 0fwWC0000000CNlYAM CurrencyIsoCode=JPY Workday_Reference_ID__c=COM071 Active. Legal_Entity_Currency__mdt Fortra_Japan_JPY Is_Primary=true. Supporting file: Data/sc3384/g08_evidence/G08_currencytype_evidence.txt. Org URL: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.my.salesforce.com/lightning/setup/CurrencySettings/home
defectStep: Admin-maintained CurrencyType.ConversionRate (not a V21 step); V21 pricing steps 33-36 are clean (use Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt). Defect surface: reports engine, DocGen FX conversion, Workday invoicing consolidation.
proposedFix: Admin must update CurrencyType.ConversionRate via Setup > Manage Currencies for ARS (666.6667), CHF (0.885), GBP (0.7874), ILS (3.6251), JPY (149.2537), NZD (1.6667). For DatedConversionRate (Advanced Currency Mgmt): add new dated rows from 2026-02-14 onward with correct rates for ARS/CHF/GBP/JPY/ILS/NZD. Remove or deactivate orphan currencies MXN/SEK if not in official scope. No procedure changes required.
notes: Config/parity scenario validated entirely by SOQL + Apex metadata queries; no DML fixture. Root-cause SPLIT: (1) reportable ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT = CurrencyType.ConversionRate placeholder 1.0 on 6 currencies feeding reports/dashboards/DocGen/downstream invoicing. (2) V21 pricing proc is CLEAN — decoupled via Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt, not CurrencyType; confirmed by G-01 PASS (EUR 500->467.3=500x0.9346 using mdt rate, not CurrencyType 0.92). (3) JPY DecimalPlaces=0 CORRECT. (4) Fortra Japan KK legal entity correctly configured. (5) CHF has no historic real rate in UAT DatedConversionRate (only 1.0 rows going back to 0000-12-30), suggesting it was always a placeholder. State identical to run1 (2026-06-29): no corrective admin action taken. Run3 remeasured 2026-06-30.
verdict_reason: 6 of 11 non-USD CurrencyType.ConversionRate values are placeholder 1.0 instead of authoritative rates. DatedConversionRate reset to 1.0 from 2026-02-11 confirmed live. Foreign currency transactions dated >= 2026-02-11 consolidate at face value affecting reports, dashboards, DocGen, and Workday invoicing. All 4 currencies named in test_setup (ARS/CHF/ILS/JPY) are at 1.0. This is an ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT (admin config defect), not a procedure defect. V21 pricing proc itself is unaffected (uses Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt with correct rates).
